content.text:
**Finding: compliant** — no MFN obligation burdens PB.

- No most-favoured-nation, best-terms or price-matching language exists anywhere in the Agreement (searches for "most favored", "(no|not) less favourable", "at least as favorable", "best price", "match", "comparable terms" returned nothing on point).
- The single "not less favorable ... to SFJ" phrase (p0543, Article 7 Security Interest) governs the terms of a replacement lender's subordination agreement — a financing condition, not an obligation to pass SFJ the benefit of better terms given to third parties.
- Article 6 (Payments to SFJ) and the Licensing Transaction provisions (p0552, § 7.5.5) impose consent/arbitration mechanics on PB's third-party licensing, but no obligation to offer SFJ equivalent or matching terms.

This sits at the playbook's **preferred** position (no MFN running against the Customer), so no redline was proposed.
